title: CutBench: AI Gameplay Clip Maker
description:
Raw footage in. Ranked clips out.CutBench is a local Windows workbench that turns your gaming sessions into a steady feed of ready-to-post vertical clips, ranked by how likely each one is to blow up. You're going to game anyway — CutBench turns that footage into TikToks, Shorts, and Reels without you ever touching a timeline. Drop a 3-hour Twitch VOD, walk away, come back to 10–15 captioned shorts sorted by virality. Your GPU does the work. Your footage never leaves your PC.

Turn gameplay into growth• Post daily without the grind. One session = a week of shorts. Stop choosing between playing and posting.

• Ranked by virality. Every clip gets a score and a one-line reason, so you know which 3 to post tonight instead of guessing.

• Built to perform on socials. 9:16 cuts, burned-in captions, and ready-made titles and hashtags tuned for TikTok, Shorts, and Reels.

• Built for gamers, not marketers. The scoring is tuned on real gaming footage — kills, clutches, banter, boss fights — not TED talks and product launches.

Why CutBench• Local-first. Your raw session — voice, game audio, every embarrassing rage moment — stays on your drive. Nothing uploaded, nothing transcoded by a stranger.

• No subscription. One-time license. Buy once, clip forever.

• No usage limits. Process as much footage as you want, as often as you want. No monthly minute quotas, no per-clip credits — it's your GPU doing the work.

How it worksA 10-stage local pipeline reads your recording end-to-end:

• INGEST — normalise and probe the source

• TRANSCRIBE — on-device speech recognition

• DETECT — find audio events, motion peaks, voice activity, scene changes

• RANK — score every candidate moment for virality

• PERCEIVE — read the on-screen action and HUD

• TRIM — walk outward from each peak to find a real beginning and ending

• RENDER — produce 9:16 (Shorts/Reels/TikTok) and 16:9 (YouTube) cuts

• LOOP — montage and time-compress to fit the format

• PACKAGE — burn captions, build thumbnails

• DESCRIPTIONS — write the title, caption, and hashtags for every clip

When the run finishes, your output folder has finished video files with subtitles, a per-clip score and reason, suggested post copy, and a ranking so you know which 3 to post tonight.

It understands what's actually happeningCutBench doesn't just cut on volume spikes. On-device AI reads the real content of your recording — what's happening on screen, who's speaking, which objects and HUD elements are visible, and which sounds are firing (gunshots, footsteps, explosions, environmental cues) — so it lands on moments that are actually worth posting. Everything runs locally on your GPU. Nothing is uploaded.

What you get per session• 10–15 ranked vertical clips per 3-hour recording

• Both 9:16 (Shorts/Reels/TikTok) and 16:9 (YouTube) renders

• Burned-in captions in multiple styles

• Suggested title, description, and hashtags per clip

• A virality score and a one-line reason for every clip

Anti-features• No timeline. If you wanted to drag clips around manually you would have opened DaVinci.

• No cloud upload. Your footage is yours.

• No "AI face filter" or "AI voice change". CutBench finds the moments, it does not fake them.

• No watermark in the paid build. (The free demo has one. This build does not.)

Made forGamers who want their gameplay to actually pay off on social media — streamers, content creators, and anyone sitting on hours of footage who wants a steady feed of shorts without learning an editor, paying a monthly fee, or shipping their gameplay to a third party.

Local-first guarantees• No telemetry. The app does not call home.

• No mandatory account. The license verifies once via Steam, then runs offline.

• No required internet. After install, you can clip on a plane.

AI content disclosureCutBench uses on-device, pre-trained AI models for visual scene understanding, audio event detection, and text generation (clip titles, captions, and hashtags). All models are bundled with the app, run on your GPU, and never transmit your input or output off your machine. No third-party AI service is contacted.
description_short: Drop a 3-hour gaming session, get back 10-15 ranked vertical clips with burned-in captions and ready-to-post titles for TikTok, Shorts and Reels. You never open a timeline. Runs locally on your GPU: no cloud, no subscription, one-time license.
